title: 导出时嵌入字体
description: Export-dialog checkbox (default on) that embeds the editor's vendored fonts as subsetted TrueType fntdata parts in the PPTX, so PowerPoint/WPS on machines without the fonts render the same faces.

export.notes: POST /api/export {format:pptx, embedFonts:true} returns a zip with ppt/fonts/fontN.fntdata (TTF magic), p:embeddedFontLst before p:defaultTextStyle, embedTrueTypeFonts="1", and application/x-fontdata content type. X-Export-Report carries embeddedFonts/skippedFonts; dialog shows 已嵌入字体 names. embedFonts:false keeps the baseline zip. Covered by packages/exporter-native/src/export-pptd.fonts.test.ts.

selfTestChecklist: POST /api/export with embedFonts:true returns PK zip containing ppt/fonts/font1.fntdata starting with 00 01 00 00 or OTTO
ppt/presentation.xml has embedTrueTypeFonts="1" and p:embeddedFontLst before p:defaultTextStyle
